summaries: Lift a document from {company2}, then {file} from {company}.
briefs:
This one has two parts, so read it through before you start.

First, {company2} in {city2} holds a document I need as leverage. Copy it and bring it back. Once I have it, I will point you at the real target: {company}.

Do them in order. Do not go near {company} until the first is done.
I need something from {company}, but you will not get in cold. {company2} in {city2} has a file that opens the way. Take that first, then I will send you on.
next: Good, that is the first part done. Now for {company}: the job I actually hired you for. You have what you need.
That will do nicely. On to {company} now. Same deal as before, just finish it.
keyNotes: Access note: the {company} box takes the shared admin login. Password is on the sticky by the rack. Nobody has changed it in a year.
Reminder to self: {company} admin creds are the same as ours. Stop writing them down.
rivals: I hear you are carrying something from {company}. I will pay more than whoever sent you. Think about it before you deliver.
Name your price for what you took from {company}. I outbid your client, whatever they offered.

briefs:
{company} in {city} is going to find out it was broken into. When it does, I want its log to name {who}, at {address}, and nobody else.

Write the line in, take yours out. Their security is {tier}.

There is a person called {who} who deserves the attention of {company}'s lawyers more than I do. Make their access log say so: a login from {address}, slipped in before you arrived.

Leave nothing of your own behind.

{rival} is about to go through {company}'s network and I cannot stop them from here. I can give you the administrator's login. Sit on the server and shut every port they try for {seconds} seconds.

That is all. You are the lock tonight.

My people at {company} in {city} have had a tip that {rival} is coming for them. Log in with the details I am sending and keep them out for {seconds} seconds. If they get in, do not bother sending a bill.
A friend of mine runs {company}'s network, and tonight someone will come for it. Be there before they arrive and stand in the doorway. Keep them out for {seconds} seconds and I will call it even.

summaries: Stay logged in on {company} for {seconds} seconds.
briefs: I need a door held open at {company} while a friend does their part. Get in, log in, and stay there for {seconds} seconds. Their trace will come for you. Be gone before it arrives, not before.
Get into {company} in {city} and sit there for {seconds} seconds. Do nothing. Touch nothing. Just keep the session alive. Their security is {tier}.

summaries: Follow a hacker's trail from {company} to their machine.
briefs:
Somebody went through {company} last night and I want to know who. Their route is in the access log. Follow it, server by server, until you reach the machine it started from.

Connect to it and I will know where to send the lawyers.
{company} in {city} was hit. The hacker bounced through several servers, and every one of them wrote a line about it. Read the logs, follow the trail, and find their machine.

summaries: Replace {file} at {company} with a doctored copy.
briefs:
I am sending you a copy of {file}. It is the same size as the one on {company}'s server, and almost the same. Delete theirs and put mine in its place.

If anyone ever opens it, they will read what I want them to read.
{company} in {city} keeps {file}. I have improved it. Swap their copy for mine, same name, same size, and leave no sign it was ever different.

summaries: A heist: lift {file} from {company} while others hold its doors.
Several connections at once against {company}, {city}. Pays like it.
A coordinated job against {company}: hold the doors, then take {file}.
briefs:
{company} keeps {file} behind everything it owns, and tonight we want it.

The vault is locked down. Its doors are run from other places: {holds}. Hold each of those desks as administrator and the door it runs swings open. Then take the file.

All at once, several lines open, several traces running. If any of them catches you, the plan is burned and so is the job.

You will need more than one line for this.

{company} in {city} has {file} on a server that answers to other servers: {holds}. Sit on those as their administrator and the vault forgets to watch. Lift the file and get out.

Get caught anywhere along the way and we never spoke.

Nobody breaks into {company} through the front. Its {file} sits behind systems run from elsewhere: {holds}.

Sit on each of those as its administrator and the vault goes quiet. Then lift the file. Lines open, traces ticking. If one catches you, the whole plan is burned, and I never heard of you.

firewall: the security desk that keeps the vault's firewall
is the vault's firewall, and the vault knows nothing without it
monitor: the monitoring desk that reports on the vault
is the eyes of the vault, and it is where the alarm starts
proxy: the proxy that guards the vault's logs
is the gate through which the vault's logs pass

briefs:
{company} in {city} is missing a file. I am sending it to your gateway now: {file}. Put it on their server, where their own people will find it and think it was always there.

It is a big file and it takes a while to send. Plan your route for that.

There is going to be an inspection at {company}, and when it comes I want {file} sitting on their system. It will be on your gateway when you take the job.

Get in, upload it, get out. Their security is {tier}.

summaries: Read three notes at {company} and name the leak.
briefs:
Something left {company} that should not have, and only three people could have sent it: {a}, {b} and {c}.

I cannot ask them. You can read what their own system says about that week. There are three notes on the {city} server that matter. Read them all, then tell me the name.

Get it right and you are paid in full. Name the wrong one and I pay half, because I will have sacked the wrong person.

{company} has a leak. Three names had access: {a}, {b}, {c}. Two of them can be ruled out by what is on the company's own server, if you read it carefully.

Read the notes, then name the one who is left. Half pay for a wrong name. Their security is {tier}.

briefs:
I spent two nights at {company} in {city} that I would like never to have spent. It is all in {file}.

{company} in {city} keeps its {records} on the server. Booking {key} needs to say "{value}" before the morning shift looks at it.

{company} in {city} is sitting on something it has not broadcast. I want to see {file} before the rest of the country does.

{company} has a file called {file}, and my name is in it. If it goes out, I am finished in {city}.

The {records} at {company} in {city} decides what goes out and when. Slot {key} should read "{value}".

{company} in {city} tested something for a firm I have money in, and the summary they published is too tidy. The working is in {file}.

Copy it for me. I would like to know what I own.

{company} ran a test that came back the wrong way for my client. The result is in {file} and it has not been sent out yet.

{company} in {city} keeps a table of {records}. Sample {key} came back with a {column} my client cannot live with.

{company} in {city} decided something last month in a room with the door shut. What they had in front of them is in {file}.

Copy it. People who live there have a right to read it, and I intend to help them.

There is a file at {company} called {file}. As long as it exists, a building of mine in {city} does not.

Delete it. Councils lose paperwork every day of the week.

{company} in {city} keeps its {records} on the server. Application {key} has been given the wrong {column}.

It should say "{value}". Their security is {tier}, which for a council is saying something.

{company} in {city} looks after money for people who would rather not be asked about it. One of them owes me. The proof is in {file}.

Copy it and bring it back. Their security is {tier}, as you would expect.

{company} holds a file called {file} that ties me to money I have told three governments I do not have.

Delete it. Be careful in there: a private bank in {city} watches its own door.

The {records} table at {company} in {city} has account {key} down wrongly, and while it does, nothing moves.

Make the {column} read "{value}". Then leave quietly.

{company} in {city} is putting something under the hammer that I mean to buy. I would bid better if I had read {file} first.

Copy it. Nobody in the saleroom needs to know I have seen it.

{company} has a file called {file} that says where a piece of mine has been. I would rather it had been nowhere.
